notes: Item Tracker alpha preview, fifth build. Unsigned, opt-in, and may change incompatibly between previews. Works with OCRX engine v2.1.1 or later. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 include. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.9.0.
changes: Changed: Locations picks a system, then a place, from two dropdowns above the list. The header stays put and only the list scrolls; item states show in an item's details instead of on every row.
Changed: A new icon, sharp in the title bar, the taskbar and the notification area.
